Browser-facing change since the previous pin: GET /api/v1/lab/order-routes, GET /api/v1/pharmacy/order-routes and support's GET /api/v1/admin/order-routes refuse a healthId query parameter with 400 HEALTH_ID_NOT_ACCEPTED_IN_URL, and support's GET finds by reference only (400 ORDER_ROUTE_LOOKUP_INVALID without one). This frontend sends a Health ID only in the body of the POST .../search routes and refuses one in those GETs' address before sending. No other route, payload or error code changed.
